name: Secrets of the Colossus - Regal
label: Quest
description: Secrets of the Colossus - Regal: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: There ain't nothin' I'd like more than to stuff this bug husk down Oilfist's fat face... Cept, I'm stuck here collectin' samples from that overgrown cockroach. I'll be here 'till the wee mornin' hours given the size o' that thing.
Take this here sample to Oilfist fer me and do it fast, adventurer. He's payin' BIG!
Yar, Thorium Point - it be in the Searin' Gorge.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent. We could surely devise some incredibly powerful armor from this chitin. Here's the riches you were promised.
